WP 2 - Technical Stewardship, Incident Response & Coordination, including core Cardano repositories: 18,800,000 ADA

request.recipient: Intersect via the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect governance coordination and technical stewardship for the Cardano ecosystem from June 2026 to June 2027.

claims.claim: Intersect states the proposal funds its core operating model for June 2026 to June 2027, including governance coordination, critical unowned processes, technical stewardship, incident response, and release coordination.
Intersect claims its overall ask decreased from $7.875M last year to $6.35M while preserving functions critical to Cardano continuity and maturity.
Intersect claims it has coordinated two network upgrades, is preparing for a third, and led ecosystem coordination during the November 2025 chain partition incident.
The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting, documentation, and audited-result references.
The proposal claims the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The proposal discloses that Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA from listed Cardano Treasury governance actions within the prior 24 months.

Independent audits and assurance for this proposal are stated to be provided by Appold, potentially including deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone-evidence assessment.

Intersect states it will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, one Project-Specific Smart Contract, defined administrator and leadership roles, and an external Oversight Committee of six entities.
The proposal provides specific TRSC and PSSC addresses and states a public dashboard will allow community audit and on-chain tracking of the withdrawn ADA.
The proposal says all milestones will be outlined within metadata when funds are transferred to the Project-Specific Smart Contract.

summary: The document requests 25,400,000 ADA for Intersect operations, technical stewardship, incident response, and critical process management over June 2026 to June 2027, with budget work packages, prior funding disclosure, smart-contract custody details, and several external references, but it does not itself provide a complete feasibility, alternatives, failure-mode, or detailed budget analysis.
